reviewNotes: WearIQ needs no account. Body scan: allow camera, prop the phone about 2-3 m away and follow the voice cues; or tap "Enter measurements manually" to type values instead (e.g. height 168, chest 90, waist 71, hips 98). To check a garment: Scan tab > "Enter a size chart manually" > category Shirt, chart shows Garment measurements, add size M with chest 112 > Analyze fit. Free plan: 5 garment checks per day; an ad (Google AdMob interstitial) plays after tapping Analyze fit and before the result. The Style tab, unlimited checks and no ads are Premium (monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription); the paywall appears from the Style tab or when the daily checks run out. Photos are processed on-device with Apple Vision and never uploaded. The Safari extension is optional and only reads clothing product pages the user allows.

• Safari uzantısı: gezdiğin giyim sayfalarında bedenin hemen orada.
• Her gün 5 ücretsiz kıyafet kontrolü.

WearIQ Premium: sınırsız kontrol, reklamsız kullanım ve Tarz sekmesi: renklerin, vücut tipine uygun kesimler, stiline göre beden, kombin önerileri ve gardırobundan kıyafetler.

en-US.name: WearIQ
en-US.subtitle: Size advice & 3D fit check
en-US.promotionalText: Know your size before you buy: measure yourself once, then see how every garment fits, on your own 3D body.
en-US.description:
WearIQ measures you once, then shows how every garment will fit you, region by region, on your own 3D body.

• Scan once: turn in front of your phone. Photos are processed on your device and never uploaded. You can also type your measurements from a tape.
• Check any garment from a product link, a barcode or a size chart screenshot. Works with hundreds of clothing stores.
• Clear verdicts like "tight", "ideal" or "loose" for shoulders, chest, waist, hips, sleeves and length, with the difference in cm.
• See it on your 3D avatar: the size you pick, draped like real fabric.
• Return risk before you order, and your size in every brand in one size passport.
• Safari extension: your size right on clothing pages as you browse.
• 5 free garment checks every day.

WearIQ Premium: unlimited checks, no ads, and the Style tab: your colours, cuts for your shape, learn-your-style sizing, pairings and outfits from your wardrobe.

Premium is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
